problem_type: Navigation requests consumed by hidden mounted workspace
symptom: Double clicking a table row opens the full-page editor but leaves the target below the viewport and unfocused.
direct_cause: The table layout effect can consume a pending row focus while its storyboard workspace is hidden, before the subsequent workspace-mode update.
class_root: A mounted view was treated as an active navigation destination without observing workspace visibility.
affected_population: Any shot-table row navigation while an existing storyboard workspace remains mounted but hidden
internal_only_reason: The invariant is enforced by the existing in-process canvasGestureContext and canvasWriteBoundary; no external API or dependency behavior changed.
invariants: Pending row navigation is consumed only by the active storyboard workspace.
generality_proof: Both table navigation entry points write the same transient focus request; gating the single consumer by active workspace covers both.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Consume navigation only after the workspace is active and the row exists.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Calls openShotTableRow, which sets focus before changing workspace.
Uses the same navigation request and consumer as double click.

recurrence.reason: Any already-mounted hidden table can consume a row request prematurely.
same_class_scan: StoryboardWorkspace.tsx states workspace stays mounted while hidden
ShotTableNode.tsx grid and footer both call openRow

prevention.invariant: Pending row navigation is consumed only by the active storyboard workspace.
prevention.failure_mode: Keep the request pending while hidden, folded, or filtered until the active view can consume it.
prevention.strategy: Subscribe to existing workspaceMode and gate the single layout-effect consumer; no timer or polling.

legacy_paths.rationale: No alternate implementation exists; the two unscoped calls are replaced in place.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: Internal mutation ownership, no third-party lifecycle involved.

migration: Transient state only; no saved project data changes.
residual_risks: The full one-window replay stopped on a platform-dependent zoom action; same-profile continuation verified the remaining UI assertions. See docs/audit/2026-09-10-shot-table-storyboard-walk.md.
